content_sections.heading: NCB Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. II/4(11)/2024/Estt./Pers I – 564 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters Degree in Cyber Security and Forensics or Digital Forensics from a recognized University or Institutes; Masters Degree in Computer Application or Computer Science from a recognized University or Institutes; Master of Technology (with specialization in Computer Application) from a recognized University or Institutes; B.E/B.Tech in Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Technology/Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology/Computer Application/Electronics/Communication Engineering from recognized University/Institute Experience: Four (04) years' experience in Cyber Security or Cyber crime or Cyber Forensic Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Officers of Central/State Government, Union territories, recognized research institutes, PSUs or statutory/autonomous organizations may apply Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or Five years' regular service in Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500) posts or equivalent; or Seven years' regular service in Level-9 (Rs 53100-167800) posts or equivalent Officers must be able to be spared at short notice if selected Desirable: Two years' experience in digital foot printing and digital forensic or certificate course in the Computing technology Industry Association

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NCB Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Advance applications will not be entertained Applications received after the closing date and conditional applications may not be entertained Applications not routed through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation including short term contract (STC) basis Period of deputation, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years Terms governed by DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time

content_sections.heading: How Will NCB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee CV information and documents on essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested certificates/documents for claimed educational qualification including essential qualification Photocopies of APARs for last five years attested on each page by an officer not below Under Secretary rank, including GAP Sheet/NIC/NRC Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance certificate as per proforma Major/minor penalty statement for the last 10 years Cadre clearance stating the officer will be relieved if selected

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCB Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the Bio-data/C.V. proforma (Annexure-I) attached to the circular. Get the employer/cadre controlling authority to countersign and give the certificate in the proforma. Enclose the listed documents: certificates, attested APARs, integrity, vigilance, penalty statement, cadre clearance. Route the application through proper channel; advance applications are not entertained. Forward to Dy Director General (P&A), Narcotics Control Bureau Headquarters, 2nd Floor, August Kranti Bhawan, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi – 110066. Application must reach within eight (08) weeks from publication of the circular in the Employment News. Make sure it reaches by 14 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature An officer who fails to join after selection will be debarred from future deputation in NCB Applicants from organizations not on Central Government pay scales may enclose the latest salary slip Queries: Landline 011-20867425 and 011-26761000/26761144 (Control Room, NCB HQ)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Director (Cyber).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCB Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae proforma attached to the circular) and send it to Dy Director General (P&A), Narcotics Control Bureau Headquarters, 2nd Floor, August Kranti Bhawan, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi – 110066, by post, to reach by 14 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the last date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-11 (Rs.67,700-2,08,700) as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters Degree in Cyber Security and Forensics or Digital Forensics, or Masters Degree in Computer Application or Computer Science, or M.Tech (Computer Application), or B.E/B.Tech in a listed computer/IT/electronics/communication discipline, plus four years' experience in Cyber Security or Cyber crime or Cyber Forensic; applicant must be an officer meeting the deputation service conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Officers of Central/State Government, Union territories, recognized research institutes, PSUs or statutory/autonomous organizations may apply. Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or. Five years' regular service in Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500) posts or equivalent; or. Seven years' regular service in Level-9 (Rs 53100-167800) posts or equivalent.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advance applications will not be entertained. Applications received after the closing date and conditional applications may not be entertained. Applications not routed through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. CV information and documents on essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation including short term contract (STC) basis. Period of deputation, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Terms governed by DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time.
